40001462.author: पदार्थः
40001462.content: तत: thereafter, अफल: having been deprived of his testacles, शक्र: Indra, त्रस्तवदन: with freightened face, सर्षिस्सङ्घान् with groups of rishis, सचारणान् with charanas, अग्निपुरोगमान् with Agni in the forefront, देवान् addressing devatas, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40001462.author: Translation
40001462.content: Deprived of testicles, Indra with a frightened face addressed hordes of rishis and charanas with agni in the forefront.

40001463.author: पदार्थः
40001463.content: महात्मन: magnanimous, गौतमस्य Gautama's, क्रोधम् wrath, उत्पाद्य evoking, तपस: austerities, विघ्नम् obstacles, कुर्वता while creating, मया by me, इदम् this, सुरकार्यम् the work of celestials, कृतम् has been done.

40001463.author: Translation
40001463.content: 'I have accomplished the objective of the devatas by creating obstacles to Gautama's  austerities, evoking in consequence the wrath of the magnanimous sage'.

40001464.author: पदार्थः
40001464.content: तेन by his, क्रोधात् wrath, अफल: deprived of testacles, कृत: अस्मि I been made, सा च also she, निराकृता was rejected, महता great, शापमोक्षेण by conferring curse, अस्य his, तप: ascetic energy, मया by me, अपहृतम् has been stolen.

40001464.author: Translation
40001464.content: 'By his (Gautama's) wrath I have been deprived of my testicles. She (Ahalya) has  been deserted by him. He has lost his ascetic energy through the pronouncement of this great curse'.

40001465.author: पदार्थः
40001465.content: तस्मात् for that reason, सर्षिसङ्घा: with hosts of rishis, सचारणा: with charanas, सर्वे all, सुरवरा: excellent devatas, सुरसाह्यकरम् for the benefit of devatas, सफलम् restoration of my testicles, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हथ it is your duty.

40001465.author: Translation
40001465.content: 'For that reason, O rishis, charanas and great devatas it is your duty to restore my testicles for the benefit I have given you'.

40001466.author: पदार्थः
40001466.content: साग्निपुरोगमा: with Agni in the forefront, देवा: devtas, शतक्रतो: Indra's (performer of one hundred sacrifices), वच: words, श्रुत्वा having heard, सर्वे all, मरुद्गणै: सह accompanied by hosts of maruts, पितृदेवान् pitrudevatas, उपेत्य having approached, आहु: said.

40001466.author: Translation
40001466.content: 'Hearing Indra, all the devatas accompanied by maruts. Lead by the Firegod devatas approached and said':

40001467.author: पदार्थः
40001467.content: अयम् this, मेष: the ram, सवृषण: has testicles, शक्र: Indra, अवृषण: is without testicles, कृत: हि has been rendered, मेषस्य ram's, वृषणौ testicles, गृह्य taking, आशु immediately, शक्राय for Indra, प्रयच्छथ furnish.

40001467.author: Translation
40001467.content: 'This ram (which has received the share of your sacrificial offerings) has testicles. As Indra has been deprived of his own take these testicles immediately and graft them on to Indra'.

40001468.author: पदार्थः
40001468.content: अफल: without testicles, कृत: made, मेष: the ram, भवताम् for you, पराम् great, तुष्टिम् joy, प्रदास्यति will give, ये मानवा: those men, दास्यन्ति will give, हर्षणार्थाय for causing delight.

40001468.author: Translation
40001468.content: The ram, rendered without testicles, will give you great satisfaction, and the men who henceforth offer such an oblation will bring you delight.

40001469.author: पदार्थः
40001469.content: समागता: assembled, पितृदेवा: pitrudevatas, अग्ने: Agni's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, मेषवृषणौ testicles of ram, उत्पाट्य extracting, सहस्राक्षे for Indra, न्यवेशयन् grafted.

40001469.author: Translation
40001469.content: Hearing the words of the Firegod the pitrudevatas assembled, uprooted the testicles of the ram and grafted them on to Indra.

40001470.author: पदार्थः
40001470.content: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, समागता: assembled, पितृदेवा: pitrudevatas, तदा प्रभृति then onwards, अफलान् without genitals, मेषान् rams, भुञ्जते accepted as offerings, तेषाम् their, फलै: their testicles, अयोजयन् having fitted.

40001470.author: Translation
40001470.content: "O Son of the Kakutsthas from then on the pitrudevatas have been accepting rams  without testicles as offerings in a sacrifice, with ram's testicles fitted on to Indra.

40001471.author: पदार्थः
40001471.content: राघव O Rama, महात्मन: illustrious, गौतमस्य Gautama's, तपस: ascetism, प्रभावेन with the power of, इन्द्र: तु Indra, तदाप्रभृति thenceforth, मेषवृषण: च testicles of ram.

40001471.author: Translation
40001471.content: O Son of the Raghus illustrious Gautama's power of ascetism was such that thenceforth Indra possessed the testicles of a ram.

40001472.author: पदार्थः
40001472.content: महातेज: O Highly lustrous Rama, तत् therefore, पुण्यकर्मण: of the pious one, आश्रमम् hermitage of Gautama, आगच्छ enter, महाभागाम् fortunate, देवरूपिणीम् woman of divine appearance, एनाम् this, अहल्यां Ahalya, तारय liberate.

40001472.author: Translation
40001472.content: "Most brilliant Rama therefore enter the hermitage of the pious (Gautama) and liberate  this fortunate Ahalya of divine appearance (from the curse)."

40001473.author: पदार्थः
40001473.content: सहलक्ष्मण: along with Lakshmana, राघव: Rama, विश्वामित्रवच: the words of Visvamitra, श्रुत्वा having listened, अथ thereafter, विश्वामित्रम् Viswamitra, पुरस्कृत्य keeping him ahead, तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitage, आविशत् entered.

40001473.author: Translation
40001473.content: In response to the words of Viswamitra Rama and Lakshmana entered the  hermitage, Viswamitra in front.

40001474.author: पदार्थः
40001474.content: महाभागाम् highly fortunate, तपसा with the power of ascetism, द्योतितप्रभाम् shining brilliantly, लोकैरपि by men, सुरासुरै: by suras or asuras, समागम्य joined together, दुर्निरीक्ष्याम् incapable of being seen, धात्रा by lord Brahma, प्रयत्नात् with special efforts, निर्मिताम् created, दिव्याम् divine, मायामयीमिव looking like illusory image, तुषारावृताम् covered by mist, साभ्राम् with clouds, पूर्णचन्द्रप्रभामिव looking like brightness of full moon, अम्भस: in the sky, मध्ये in the midst, दुराधर्षाम् inviolable, दीप्ताम् shining, सूर्यप्रभामिव like brightness of sun, स: Rama, ददर्श beheld.

40001474.author: Translation
40001474.content: Rama beheld the highly fortunate Ahalya, shining brilliantly with the power of her asceticism. She could not be seen even by men, suras or asuras joined together. She looked  divine and illusory as if created with special efforts by Brahma. Though not clearly visible, she was shining bright like the light of the full Moon muffled by mists in the sky and like the inviolable light of the Sun reflected in the water.

40001475.author: पदार्थः
40001475.content: महाभागाम् highly fortunate, तपसा with the power of ascetism, द्योतितप्रभाम् shining brilliantly, लोकैरपि by men, सुरासुरै: by suras or asuras, समागम्य joined together, दुर्निरीक्ष्याम् incapable of being seen, धात्रा by lord Brahma, प्रयत्नात् with special efforts, निर्मिताम् created, दिव्याम् divine, मायामयीमिव looking like illusory image, तुषारावृताम् covered by mist, साभ्राम् with clouds, पूर्णचन्द्रप्रभामिव looking like brightness of full moon, अम्भस: in the sky, मध्ये in the midst, दुराधर्षाम् inviolable, दीप्ताम् shining, सूर्यप्रभामिव like brightness of sun, स: Rama, ददर्श beheld.

40001475.author: Translation
40001475.content: Rama beheld the highly fortunate Ahalya, shining brilliantly with the power of her asceticism. She could not be seen even by men, suras or asuras joined together. She looked  divine and illusory as if created with special efforts by Brahma. Though not clearly visible, she was shining bright like the light of the full Moon muffled by mists in the sky and like the inviolable light of the Sun reflected in the water.

40001476.author: पदार्थः
40001476.content: सा she, गौतमवाक्येन with the words of Gautama, रामस्य Rama's, दर्शनम्यावत् till the appearance of Rama, त्रयाणामपि लोकानाम् even for three worlds, दुर्निरीक्ष्या incapable of being seen by any, बभूव ह became.

40001476.author: Translation
40001476.content: By the words of Gautama, she became invisible to the three worlds till the appearance of Rama.

40001477.author: पदार्थः
40001477.content: शापस्य curse's, अन्तम् end, उपागम्य having reached, तेषाम् their, दर्शनम् appearance, आगता obtained, तत: afterwards, राघवौ Rama and Lakshmana, तदा then, तस्या: her, पादौ feet, जगृहतु: touched.

40001477.author: Translation
40001477.content: With the expiry of the period of the curse, the Raghavas (Rama and Lakshmana) speared and she became perceptible when Rama touched her feet.

40001478.author: पदार्थः
40001478.content: सा च she also, गौतमवच: words of Gautama, स्मरन्ती recalling, तौ them, प्रतिजग्राह received with due honours, सुसमाहिता with concentration of mind and attention, पाद्यम् water for washing feet, अर्घ्यम् offerings of reverence, तथा and, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, विधिदृष्टेन according to tradition, कर्मणा by acts, चकार performed, काकुत्स्थः Kakusthsa, प्रतिजग्राह received.

40001478.author: Translation
40001478.content: Recalling the words of Gautama, she received them with water to wash their feet and offerings made with due devotion Rama accepted her hospitality extended in accordance tradition.

40001479.author: पदार्थः
40001479.content: सा च she also, गौतमवच: words of Gautama, स्मरन्ती recalling, तौ them, प्रतिजग्राह received with due honours, सुसमाहिता with concentration of mind and attention, पाद्यम् water for washing feet, अर्घ्यम् offerings of reverence, तथा and, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, विधिदृष्टेन according to tradition, कर्मणा by acts, चकार performed, काकुत्स्थः Kakusthsa, प्रतिजग्राह received.

40001479.author: Translation
40001479.content: Recalling the words of Gautama, she received them with water to wash their feet and offerings made with due devotion Rama accepted her hospitality extended in accordance tradition.

40001480.author: पदार्थः
40001480.content: देवदुन्दुभिनिस्वनै: amidst sounds of divine kettle drums, महती great, पुष्पवृष्टि आसीत् flowers rained, गंधर्वाप्सरसाम् चैव of gandharvas and apsarasas also, महान् great, समागम: union  आसीत् took place.

40001480.author: Translation
40001480.content: Amidst sounds of celestial kettledrums, devatas showered flowers, gandharvas sang and apsarasa danced. There was a great assemblage (of divinities).

40001481.author: पदार्थः
40001481.content: गौतमस्य Gautama's, वशानुगाम् in the possession of, तपोबलविशुद्धाङ्गीम् her body purified by the power of penance, ताम् that, अहल्याम् Ahalya, देवा: devatas, साधु साधु इति 'Excellent', 'Excellent', समपूजयन् exclaimed.

40001481.author: Translation
40001481.content: On seeing Ahalya, her body purified by the power of penance at Gautama's command, the devatas worshipfully exclaimed, 'Excellent, Excellent'

40001482.author: पदार्थः
40001482.content: महातपा: possessed of great ascetism, महातेजा: highly glorious, गौतमोऽपि Gautama also, अहल्यासहित: accompanied by Ahalya, सुखी full of joy, रामम् Rama, विधिवत् according to tradition, सम्पूज्य having worshipped, तप: austerities, तेपे performed.

40001482.author: Translation
40001482.content: Brilliant Gautam, the great ascetic, along with Ahalya, worshipped Rama  according to tradition, with delight and continued with his austerities.

40001483.author: पदार्थः
40001483.content: रामोऽपि Rama also, गौतमस्य महामुने: of the great ascetic Gautama, सकाशात् from him, परमाम् great, पूजाम् hospitality, विधिवत् according to tradition, प्राप्य having received, मिथिलाम् towards Mithila, जगाम had gone.

40001483.author: Translation
40001483.content: Having received due hospitality from the great ascetic Gautama Rama also set out towards Mithila. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे एकोनपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyninth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
